portable_scope: Supports re-scoring all 360 ensembles, forecasts and interval outputs with included labels, and reconstruction of all fixed climate means from raw responses/receipts. Does not include full-country native hourly generation, old GFS caches or original matched/full-year banks, hence not a full clean-machine native-data retraining package. Joblib heads are own trusted artifacts. All source-only posthoc diagnostics use labels and are not deployed predictions.
